2024
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice C. V. Bhaskar Reddy
 Writ Petition No.29207 of 2015
Order:

This Writ Petition, under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, is filed by the petitioner, seeking the following relief:
"...to issue an order or direction more particularly one in the nature of Writ of Mandamus declaring the action of the respondents in taking steps to disposes the petitioner from the possession of her land in Sy.No.424/AA, admeasuring Ac.1-09 guntas situated at Kanaipally Village, Kothakota Mandal, Mahabubnagar District which is the item No.5 of the 4(1) notification, dated 10.01.2013 without issuing any notice to conduct award enquiry and without making the payment of the compensation in respect of the above land as illegal, unlawful and contrary to law and consequently direct the respondents not to dispossess the petitioner from the possession of the above land unless, until the compensation is paid to the petitioner under the provisions of Act, 30 of 2013 i.e., "The Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013", and pass..."
2.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Heard the learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.

3. The case of the petitioner is that she is the absolute owner and possessor of the wet land to an extent of Ac.1.09 guntas in Sy.No.424/AA, situated at Kanaipally Village, Kothakota Mandal,
Mahabubnagar District, having acquired the same through registered Gift deed vide document No.1502/1984, dated 08.06.1984 and got her name mutated in the revenue records as Pattadar and the revenue authorities have also issued Pattadar Passbook vide patta bearing No.463.
4.

It is the further case of the petitioner that respondent No.3 issued notification under Section 4(1)
of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 with a proposal to acquire the land in Sy.No.424, admeasuring Ac.1.37 guntas including the lands of the petitioner to an extent of Ac.1.09 guntas forming part of Sy.No.424/AA, for the purpose of Rajiv Gandhi Lift Irrigation Scheme for construction of Shankara Samudram Balancing Reservoir Right Channel.

entities.text: Shankara Samudram Balancing Reservoir Right Channel
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
The grievance of the petitioner is that even though notification was issued on 10.01.2013, the respondents have not proceeded further for publication of notification in the District Gazette or issuance of proceedings under Section 6(1) of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 or passing of an award under Sections 11 and 12 of the Land Acquisition Act,
1894.

6. This writ petition is pending on the file of this Court since last one decade and no counter-affidavit has been filed by the respondents stating that they have concluded the proceedings issued under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 before the statutory period prescribed under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 or Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement (RFCTLARR) Act, 2013.
7.

opennyai_summary.PREAMBLE:
B.Satyamma vs The State Of Tg.,Rep By Its ... on 12 August,
2024
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice C. V. Bhaskar Reddy
 Writ Petition No.29207 of 2015
Order:
This Writ Petition, under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, is filed by the petitioner, seeking the following relief:
"...to issue an order or direction more particularly one in the nature of Writ of Mandamus declaring the action of the respondents in taking steps to disposes the petitioner from the possession of her land in Sy.No.424/AA, admeasuring Ac.1-09 guntas situated at Kanaipally Village, Kothakota Mandal, Mahabubnagar District which is the item No.5 of the 4(1) notification, dated 10.01.2013 without issuing any notice to conduct award enquiry and without making the payment of the compensation in respect of the above land as illegal, unlawful and contrary to law and consequently direct the respondents not to dispossess the petitioner from the possession of the above land unless, until the compensation is paid to the petitioner under the provisions of Act, 30 of 2013 i.e., "The Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013", and pass..."
2.
opennyai_summary.facts:
It is the further case of the petitioner that respondent No.3 issued notification under Section 4(1)
of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 with a proposal to acquire the land in Sy.No.424, admeasuring Ac.1.37 guntas including the lands of the petitioner to an extent of Ac.1.09 guntas forming part of Sy.No.424/AA, for the purpose of Rajiv Gandhi Lift Irrigation Scheme for construction of Shankara Samudram Balancing Reservoir Right Channel.
The grievance of the petitioner is that even though notification was issued on 10.01.2013, the respondents have not proceeded further for publication of notification in the District Gazette or issuance of proceedings under Section 6(1) of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 or passing of an award under Sections 11 and 12 of the Land Acquisition Act,
1894.
opennyai_summary.arguments: Sri M. Damodar Reddy, learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that so far the respondents have neither taken actual physical possession of the land, nor followed the procedure as contemplated under the provisions of Land Acquisition Act, 1894 by passing an award.
opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS:
6. This writ petition is pending on the file of this Court since last one decade and no counter-affidavit has been filed by the respondents stating that they have concluded the proceedings issued under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 before the statutory period prescribed under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 or Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement (RFCTLARR) Act, 2013.
7.
opennyai_summary.decision:
In view of the proceedings issued under the old Act have been lapsed, this wit petition is allowed and the notification issued under Section 4(1) of Land Acquisition Act, 1894 by the respondents is set aside.
There shall be no order as to costs.
As a sequel thereto, miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending shall stand closed.
